plainLanguage: Section 45 inakataza advised attempt ya kuwatoa members wa vyombo vilivyotajwa kwenye duty/allegiance, kuwachochea mutiny au traitorous/mutinous act, au kuwachochea kufanya mutinous assembly.
meaning: The provision focuses on an advised attempt to achieve one of three specified purposes involving members of the Police Force, Prisons Service, National Service or another law-enforcement organ.
keyPoints: The targeted person must fall within a listed service or other law-enforcement organ.
The stated penalty is imprisonment for life.

legalTerms.meaning: Uasi wa aina inayotambuliwa na provision dhidi ya duty/authority ndani ya service husika.
Wording ya statutory inayohitaji intentional/deliberate attempt; facts lazima zipimwe dhidi ya element hiyo.

examples.title: Element check
examples.scenario: Prosecution allegation is assessed against the exact wording of this section.
examples.analysis: Kila statutory element lazima ithibitishwe; label ya offence peke yake haitoshi.

history.summary: Section 45 forms part of Chapter VII, Treason and Other Offences Against the Republic.
notes: Official wording checked against the R.E. 2022 source before explanation.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo A
expertPerspectives.view: Analysis should follow the exact statutory verbs and mental elements rather than a broad description of the alleged conduct.

expertPerspectives.label: Mtazamo B
expertPerspectives.view: The evidence should be matched separately to each required element and any express qualification in the provision.

debateQuestion: Je, evidence inayodaiwa inathibitisha kila element ya section 45 bila kupanua wording ya statute?
disclaimer: Ufafanuzi huu si maandishi rasmi ya sheria.
